data.title: Unit 2 : The Animal World
Types of Animals
data.text: As the larva grows, it sheds its skin.
The larva is fed by worker bees. Worker bees are female bees that cannot produce eggs.
The worker bee seals the top of the cell. The larva becomes a pupa after 8 to 9 days.
